QA Automation Engineer – Simulation Engines & Cloud Services

Location: Berlin, Germany (Hybrid: 3 days in-office)
Position Type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary Range: €60,000-75,000 / year (commensurate with experience)
Work Authorization: Applicants must currently reside in Germany and possess full unrestricted work authorization.

About the Company & Role

Our client is a global and independent leader in digital environmental engineering and sustainability solutions. They deliver industry-leading modeling software, advisory services, and cloud platforms dedicated to solving critical water and environmental challenges worldwide.

We are seeking an experienced QA Automation Engineer to join their team in Berlin. This role offers a unique and stimulating challenge split evenly between two key product domains:

• 50% Simulation Engines: Validating high-performance numerical software, scientific correctness, time-series datasets, and calculation performance.
• 50% Cloud Services & Platforms: Automating REST/gRPC APIs, integration workflows, and web services connected to scalable cloud infrastructure.

Working in an international, collaborative environment, you will work alongside software developers, scientists, and domain experts based across Berlin, Denmark, and the Czech Republic.

Key Responsibilities

• Framework Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks for simulation calculation engines and cloud platforms.
• Scientific Data & Output Validation: Develop automated regression suites to validate numerical calculations, time-series data, and output correctness against strict scientific tolerance criteria.
• Performance Benchmarking: Design and execute performance and benchmarking strategies from scratch to profile calculation speed, memory usage, and CPU multi-threading during heavy simulation runs.
• API & System Integration: Perform automated API testing (REST and gRPC) and conduct end-to-end integration testing across backend services.
• CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated test suites into continuous delivery pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions or TeamCity) running in containerized environments.
• Root-Cause Analysis: Investigate test failures across application code, simulation engines, compilers, dependencies, and configuration layers.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with remote software engineering and scientific teams to define quality criteria and expected test outcomes.

Your Profile & Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Experience: Ideally 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in Quality Engineering and Test Automation.
• Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in C# and Python for test framework development and scripting.
• Data & Backend Focus: Solid experience handling and asserting numerical outputs, time-series data, or large scientific datasets.
• API & UI Testing: Experience with REST/gRPC API testing and basic knowledge of UI test automation tools (e.g., Playwright or Selenium).
• CI/CD & Containers: Hands-on experience executing tests within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/TeamCity) and familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes containerized environments.
• Performance Testing: Demonstrated experience in performance, stress, or scalability testing.
• Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across distributed remote teams.

Nice to Have:

• Prior experience with engineering, simulation, or scientific modeling software.
• Knowledge of cloud services (Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Batch, Azure Blob Storage).
• Experience with database validation (PostgreSQL).
• Exposure to low-level compiled languages (C, C++, or Fortran).

What Is Offered

• Purpose-driven work contributing to global sustainability and environmental protection.
• High impact on quality practices and software development from concept to release.
• A highly collaborative, international, and expert team environment.
• Flexible working model with hybrid office arrangements in Berlin.
• Competitive compensation package and professional growth opportunities.

jobs.job_description: Stellenbezeichnung: Software engineer, AI model supply chain and package security arbeitnow prefix.dev GmbH 10/14/2026 We build fast, modern developer tools in Rust, and a surprising amount of serious software runs on them. Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. We are also core maintainers of conda-forge, one of the largest open source package ecosystems, and we maintain Robo Stack, which gets ROS running on any OS from a single lockfile.When that much software flows through your tools, security stops being optional. Every package that ends up on a laptop, a server or a robot should be traceable back to the source and build that produced it. We're building that for conda today, and we want to extend it to AI models.The engineering team is spread across Europe (Netherlands, Germany, UK, Moldova). This work is based in Berlin, and so is this role.The workRobots increasingly run learned models: vision transformers, RL policies, LLMs. Today those models are usually copied onto machines as large opaque files, with little record of where they came from or what changed. We think models should be shipped like packages: versioned, signed, verifiable, and updated efficiently.You'll work on two related areas.Package security. Signing and verification for conda packages with Sigstore, provenance from source to build to install, SBOMs, and mapping known vulnerabilities onto the packages people actually use. This work goes into Pixi, rattler and conda-forge, and is used by a lot of people.AI models as packages. Taking the same ideas to model artifacts. That includes:A provenance chain from training through packaging to deployment, with signatures that can be verified offline on air-gapped robotsA model SBOM format, building on CycloneDX's ML-BOMDelta updates between model versions (full models, fine-tunes, LoRA adapters, quantized variants), so robots don't download gigabytes for a small changeCompression that combines model techniques (quantization, pruning, distillation) with what package managers already do well (zstd, content-addressable storage), tuned to the target hardware and networkManaging models that get fine-tuned on the robot itself: tracking where those variants came from, validating them, and syncing them backTesting the whole pipeline end to end on real models and real hardware, and measuring latency, bandwidth and model qualityA lot of this is new. Part of the job is figuring out which approaches work, measuring them honestly, and writing up what you found.What we're looking forYou don't need years of experience. You do need solid fundamentals, curiosity, and the patience to get security details right.Rust, or a strong background in C++, Go or Python and the wish to switchInterest in software supply chain security. Bonus if you've worked with Sigstore (Cosign, Rekor, Fulcio), TUF, in-toto, SLSA or SBOM formatsFamiliarity with ML in practice: you've trained or fine-tuned a model, know what a LoRA adapter or a quantized model is, and have used PyTorch or similarBasic understanding of cryptography as an engineer: signatures, hashes, certificates, and what they do and don't guaranteeYou like measuring things and are honest about results that don't work outYou live in Berlin or are willing to move hereIt's a plus if you know package managers from the inside, have worked on model compression or edge inference, have robotics experience, or have contributed to open source. None of this is required.What we offerYou'll work on problems few people have solved yet, together with the people who created Mamba, Pixi, rattler and Robo Stack. Most of your work will be open source and used by a large community from day one. We pay a competitive Berlin salary, with 30 days of vacation, the hardware you want, a conference budget, and time for upstream open source work. THE ROLE & THE TEAM

As a Senior Software Engineer (Data/ML) in the Pricing Platform department you will be responsible for building cutting-edge algorithmic pricing solutions that are essential for optimising profit and managing the stock risk across all articles on the Zalando platform. You will make these products reliable in production. You will build the data software deployment and monitoring foundations that allow models to move safely from experimentation into daily commercial use.

This is an engineering role at the intersection of data platforms machine learning optimisation and product development. You will work closely with Applied Scientists Product Managers Engineers and commercial stakeholders to turn ambiguous problems into trusted scalable systems.

Learn more about our Software engineering team and how we work together WED LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)

• Build and operate production systems for data ingestion optimisation forecasting and machine learning
• Design scalable data and ML pipelines using Python Databricks Spark and Airflow with clear data contracts and reliable failure handling.
• Enable Applied scientists to develop and evaluate models efficiently by providing reusable training evaluation deployment and experiment-tracking capabilities.
• Productionise models: define dependable inputs and outputs automate deployment monitor quality and performance and make model behaviour traceable in production.
• Develop and operate workloads in the appropriate execution environment: Databricks jobs for distributed data and ML processing and Dockerised applications running as Kubernetes pods where that runtime is needed.
• Build operational dashboards alerts and runbooks so that users and engineers can understand system state identify issues and respond effectively.
• Work with product and commercial partners to convert business rules and decision requirements into maintainable software components.
• Raise the engineering bar through pragmatic standards for system design testing code review CI/CD observability and operational ownership.

WED LOVE TO MEET YOU IF

• You have 4 years of experience building and running data or ML systems in production for example in MLOps data engineering ML platforms or ML product development.
• You write maintainable production Python and follow established software-delivery practices including automated testing code review and CI/CD.
• Youre strong in software engineering fundamentals: reliability scalability observability and maintainable system design.
• You understand how cloud workloads are deployed and run including AWS Docker containers and Kubernetes-based execution.
• You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy turning ambiguous problems into dependable systems.
• Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Co-pilot Codex or Claude Code is welcome.
